Updated koko from v0.4.0 to v0.3.1 at ~/.local/bin/koko.
Commands from now on run v0.3.1. Open SSH Sessions, koko web and the v0.4.0 Device Mux carry on, and the Device Mux exits after 10 minutes idle.
v0.3.1 has no koko update: to come back to a later release, run the install line again: curl -fsSL https://github.com/cieons/koko/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
